_doc: CAMINETTO dating cabinet (#21, built 2026-07-18 — Wave B opener). THE THREE-LIVES LADDER: (1) original 'I tre Camini' 1968-1979/80 (Peppino Ascorti + Luigi Radice, Gianni Davoli distributing; slender moustache logo: bird-in-flight -> double comma); (2) HIATUS ~1980-1985 (Radice left Dec-1979, Ascorti left early-1980 -> Sergio ~3mo -> Ascorti brand; old workshop burned; brand 'all but disappeared'); (3) revival 1986 by Roberto Ascorti (big moustache + REAL YEAR CODE in stamp: year = 1985 + n, grid '54/6/2/01' = 1986); (4) relaunch 2013 by Tommi Ascorti (grandson, one-man shop, Event line). SOURCES (local-first per CABINET_METHOD): staging/pipedia/Caminetto.json + The_History_of_Caminetto…json (joshoowah/BoB post adopted by pipedia) + pipephil logo-c1 mirror + smokingpipes blog 'The Renaissance of Caminetto Pipes' (Stanion 2023, Tommi interview — family source; mirrored in brand_research/caminetto_dating/). Honesty flags: moustache eras are circa -> encoded wide; 'Hand Made in Italy Cucciago (Co)' wording spans BOTH periods (pipephil shows it on new-period pipes) -> NOT a cliff; Tommi-era possible pre-2013 gap NOT encoded (Ferrari analogy = market perception, no documented stop year); Tinder Box Golden Anniversary ~1978 approx -- verify.

history_anchors._doc: 1959 Peppino Ascorti hired at Castello. End 1968: leaves, founds Caminetto in Cucciago (Radice joins end-1968 per pipedia / 1969 per smokingpipes — one-year conflict noted). Davoli (Milan tobacconist) = sole distributor -> co-owner (majority by 1973); Tinder Box = US chain contract; production 3,000->7,000/yr. Dec 1979 Radice leaves (-> Radice brand). Early 1980 Ascorti leaves w/ whole crew -> 'Sergio' pipes ~3 months (800-1,000 made) -> Ascorti brand. Old workshop burns down ~1980-81. Peppino dies 1984. ~1985 Roberto Ascorti buys the name; official new production + retail 1986 (grid year-code 01). 2013 Tommi Ascorti (b.1989) buys brand from family, relaunches as one-man shop; Event line = annual special edition (copper accent, old shapes remade). Noise: Capitello (Enzo Galluzzo, 1982-1991) = Caminetto-lookalike fallout brand; Ascorti-brand pipes resemble 1976-81 Caminettos; Harvey Greif may have stamped his own property-claim marks.

brand_marks.physical: Moustache stem logo in gold or white (gold on Prestige-grade smooths). Old shank stamps: #1 'ASCORTI/RADICE/CUCCIAGO/CANTU-ITALY' (earliest, often w/ crest), #2 'HAND MADE IN ITALY/CUCCIAGO (Co)', #3 'MADE IN ITALY/CUCCIAGO (CANTU)'. 'Caminetto' in script OR block-in-quotes on early pipes (both, not a discriminator). New period: script Caminetto + 2x2 grid (shape/finish/series/YEAR) or 3-part stamp (finish + letter L or B + YEAR). Finish digits: 0 std smooth, 1 top straight-grain, 2 smooth natural, 6 sandblast, 7 New Dear, 8 Business. KS/KS1-3 = size. Tinder Box shield = US retail provenance.

date_code._doc: NEW-PERIOD YEAR CODE (1986+ Roberto revival): last number of the 2x2 grid (shape/finish/series/YEAR) or of the 3-part stamp (finish/letter/YEAR) = year of manufacture, year = 1985 + n. Exemplar: 54/6/2/01 = 1986 (joshoowah's birth-year pipe; 'official production and retail sale did not begin until 1986', some hold 1985 -> base honors the majority reading). Old-period pipes carry NO year code. EXACT tier.

line_years._notes: business: the classic rusticated line from the original period, revived 1986 (rustication changed somewhat) -> FLOOR 1968 only. new dear: Peppino-era wax-drip finish, continued by Roberto AND Tommi -> floor 1968. event: Tommi's annual special edition (copper accent) -> floor 2013 (smokingpipes blog). tinder box golden anniversary: 250+51 made for Tinder Box's golden anniversary ~1978 (chain founded 1928 — approx -- verify) -> [1977,1979]. NOT encoded (documented names, no intro dates; several span both periods per pipephil): bagdad, damasco, double bowl, twin bowl, excellence (+extra/flame), green briar, red briar, sable d'or, torch, moustache/super moustache. 'gianni' private label (Davoli, Italy, 1970s 'couple of years') = undated, parked. Sergio = separate 1980 brand, never a Caminetto stamp.

table.label: shank stamp ASCORTI/RADICE/CUCCIAGO/CANTU-ITALY = earliest production; Radice's name cannot postdate his Dec-1979 exit -> 1968-1980

channels_future.com_wording: 'HAND MADE IN ITALY / CUCCIAGO (Co)' vs 'MADE IN ITALY / CUCCIAGO (CANTU)': difference undated AND #2 wording documented on new-period pipes (pipephil Excellence example) -> no cliff encodable. If a source ever dates the #2/#3 split, add a com_stamp table.
channels_future.grid_letter: New-period 3-part stamp letter (usually L, sometimes B) — meaning unknown to all sources; if decoded (e.g. L = line?), could refine.
channels_future.moustache_color: gold vs white moustache = grade signal (gold on Prestige smooths), not dating.
channels_future.tommi_gap: Whether Roberto-era production ran continuously 1986->2013 is UNDOCUMENTED (Tommi's 'Ferrari stopped 20 years' = US-market perception). If a stop year surfaces, split the revival era.
